Read native MATERIAL phase densities as well as Calm and FifthOrder wave-object densities and boundary bindings. Establish an explicitly matched C01 with water=1000 kg/m3 and air=1.2 kg/m3; do not infer matching material densities from object constants or report normalization.

Compare corrected W01 to the specifically accepted C01 using raw exact-cycle integrals and four consecutive settled full cycles aligned by local x=-.5 m gauge, not force phases; assess mean CL/CD, amplitude, RMS, phase, Q and numerical health.

forcing_gate: Inspect actual applicable forcing/damping near foil, flux/source and field finiteness. Invalid sentinel fields are not zeros; review native fields on a new copy without repeating failed whole-domain export. No falsified gate PASS.
